senses.gloss: to cut, diminish; פָּסֵד (cmp. פגם, פסל) to lose in value, deteriorate.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:1:2">Y. Maasr. V, beg. 51ᶜ</cite> <he>שהן פְּסֵידִין</he> because they spoil; <he>חטין אינן פ׳</he> wheat does not spoil.

senses.gloss: to suffer loss, to lose, be at a disadvantage.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:4">B. Mets. III, 4</cite>, sq. <he>אם כן מה ה׳ הרמאי</he> if this is the law, what does the dishonest man lose (what risk does he run to prevent him from claiming more than his due)? <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:2">Ber. I, 2</cite> <he>הקורא … לא ה׳</he> he who reads the Sh’mʿa after this, loses nothing; expl.

<cite ref="Berakhot 10b">ib. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ה׳ ברכות</he> he does not lose the benedictions (he may recite the benedictions preceding and following the Sh’mʿa as usual). Y. ib. I, 2ᵇ top <he>אין תפלה מַפְסֶדֶת</he> a prayer never loses its value.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:3">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> <he>נדרו והִפְסִידוּ</he> vowed and suffered thereby.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:3">Keth. XIII, 3</cite> <he>אדמון אומר … הִפְסַרְתִּי</he> upon which Admon said, shall I be at a disadvantage, because I am a male heir?; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:6">Tosef. Bets. II, 6</cite> <he>שמא יַפְסִידוּ את וכ׳</he> lest they do harm to the inhabitants; a. e.—[Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot. <he>והפסיד אלא</he>, read: <he>והפשיר עמו</he>, v. <cite ref="Q02098"><he>פָּשַׁר</he></cite>.]
Pes. 50ᵇ יש זריז ונ׳, v. זָרִיז; Tosef. Yeb. IV, 8 ומַפְסִיד (Hif.).
